commands.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; echo source_head=$(git rev-parse origin/main); SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "$SERIAL"; echo serial=$SERIAL; echo '--- pm path ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye || true; echo '--- packages matching blueeye ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm list packages | grep -i blueeye || true; echo '--- pid ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye || true; echo '--- service ---'; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q ScannerService; then echo scanner_service=present; else echo scanner_service=absent; fi
